content:
**Static Sawgill** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

A common fish that can be caught with Bait - Common and Bait - Improved. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 10 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Static Sawgill (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (1) | 

Can be found at any fishing spot in Skyline Valley.
